c = 'winegcc'
ar = 'ar'
strip = 'strip'

[built-in options]
c_args = ['-m64', '--no-gnu-unique', '-D__WINESRC__']

[properties]
needs_exe_wrapper = true
winelib = true

system = 'linux'
cpu_family = 'x86_64'
cpu = 'x86_64'
